_comment: Permission policy for the grc-snapshot-push role. Replace <AWS_ACCOUNT_ID> before use.
Deliberately narrower than infra/governance-api-policy.json: this role only reads and
replaces one item in one table. No UpdateItem, no DeleteItem, no Scan, no Query, and
nothing outside DynamoDB. If this role leaked, the worst case is overwriting a
prototype snapshot that is regenerated from source anyway.
